basis: Owner directive 2026-10-23: real cinematic motion instead of still images, licensed footage allowed. Technical and speech gates copied unchanged from pilot-qa-criteria-v3. Grammar: scenes 6-14 s (v3 18-36 s scored pacing 6.5, pilot-008), at least 40 % of the picture time real footage, same repeat gap, title card, captions and CTA rules. Rights: FLUX/SDXL stills as in v3 plus footage only under an accepted licence, vetted on its frame sheet (no people, text or branding) and credited in the description. pilot-qa-criteria-v3 stays frozen and unchanged.

technical.video: 1920x1080, H.264, 30 fps, one audio stream (AAC 48 kHz stereo)

failure_policy: Any FAIL blocks approval; criteria are not edited after results to pass.
not_claimed: Audience response, CTR, retention or revenue
perceptual_review_required_before_approv: Watched review (long_review.watch); owner floor: overall >= 9.5 for new uploads.
